baseline_audit.prompt_ir_schema: core/prompt_ir.py ShotIR dataclass with defaults for duration/camera/transition/purpose/style/retention and loose AssetBinding/VisualFact records
image_consumers: api/server.py prompt compile/export and image task paths
prompt_preview_export: api/server.py prompt preview, version, export and readiness endpoints
baseline_audit.asset_binding_logic: api/server.py rebuilds prompt_compile_context from visual registry and references; legacy fields can include authority_prompt_raw and reference tokens
baseline_audit.reference_logic: reference token and image readiness are mixed into prompt_compile_context; missing reference could still be verbalized as '以对应参考图为准'
baseline_audit.qa_qualification: compiler diagnostics/executability persisted in meta_info and readiness, without a versioned PromptIR pointer
baseline_audit.authority_risk: Prompt strings and legacy compiler state live on StoryboardShot; no PromptIR version/pointer separated serialization from authority.
baseline_audit.missing_vs_blocking: Previous compiler could produce structurally valid ShotIR from incomplete context because dataclass defaults masked missing production facts.

final_as_built_verification.production_input: Only current StoryboardMaterializationPointer -> authoritative StoryboardShot -> storyboard_prompt_handoff_v1
final_as_built_verification.prompt_ir_schema: prompt_ir_authority_v1 structured payload; storyboard facts, asset constraints, compiler policy, retention policy, diagnostics and readiness are separate sections
final_as_built_verification.raw_prompt_policy: authority_prompt_raw is never used by the production PromptIR compiler; only structured authoritative visual_facts may enter hard constraints.
final_as_built_verification.serialization: static_prompt, motion_prompt and negative_prompt are derived adapter output; they are not PromptIR authority.
